facilities.name: Hasteröd stage-start parking
facilities.description: Very small stage-start parking near Hasterod information sign, fitting about 2-3 cars. Official WST warns not to park along roadsides, on private land or on landowner driveways. Coordinate is official endpoint, not a separately surveyed parking polygon.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Store Väktor
facilities.description: High-confidence wind shelter by Store Vaktor, about 15 m from the official route near km 7.68. Overnight shelter is confirmed; Vindskyddskartan reports a small capacity of about two people. Fire/grill metadata must be handled separately because Bredfjallet reserve rules prohibit fires. Shelter lies inside a protected-area context; do not generalize tenting/camping permission from shelter presence.

facilities.name: Vargfjället
facilities.description: Private farm/service point around km 12 with well water, toilet and shower for voluntary contribution; WST says a very simple overnight cabin may be available by contacting the owners. Private service point; not guaranteed always-open public water. Voluntary contribution and owner-contact caveats should be preserved.
